subject: Trading
title: GameStop and Meme Stocks: 2021
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: GameStop and Meme Stocks: 2021.

hook.text: Reddit traders squeezed hedge funds short on GameStop, driving it from $20 to $483 in weeks. Then it crashed back.

buildup.text: WallStreetBets identified GameStop as heavily shorted. Coordinated buying forced shorts to cover at huge losses.

discovery.text: The short squeeze cost Melvin Capital billions and raised questions about market fairness and manipulation.

twist.text: Robinhood restricted buying of GameStop, enraging retail traders who accused brokers of protecting hedge funds.

climax.text: Most late buyers lost money as the stock crashed from its highs. The last ones in became the biggest losers.

punchline.text: The crowd can move markets. But timing the exit is what matters.

quiz.question: What happened to most late buyers of GameStop during the squeeze?
options: They lost money as the stock crashed from its highs
